# serverroom_reverse_dns (Resource)

The reverse DNS (PTR) name of one of your server's addresses. Destroying it leaves the name as it is: an address always has a reverse name, and ours is restored only by support.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "serverroom_server" "web" {
  account_id = 246447
}

resource "serverroom_reverse_dns" "web" {
  ip   = data.serverroom_server.web.ipv4[0]
  name = "web-01.example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip` (String)
- `name` (String) The host name the address should answer to.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import serverroom_reverse_dns.web 203.0.113.10
```
